anomalies.observed: The UART3 connector signals are tied to FCC1 pins 73 and 48, which are the two VCAP (power_out) pins of the STM32H753VITx. The UART3 TX/RX nets never reach a UART-capable pin such as PB10/PB11 (pins 46/47). PB10 (pin 46) is left unconnected.
anomalies.expected: UART3 TX/RX should land on the MCU's USART3 pins. VCAP pins must not carry signals; they need a 2.2 uF capacitor to ground. C13 (2u2) on the FCC sheet has its pad 1 unconnected, so the VCAP filtering is also not wired.
anomalies.impact: The UART3 link to the connector cannot communicate, and the internal core regulator's VCAP pins are loaded by a signal path and lack their required 2.2 uF decoupling. The FCC core may be unstable or fail to start.

anomalies.observed: PCA9685 address-select pin A0 (pin 1) is tied to the +3.3V rail, so the device address is 0x41, not the 0x40 the spec lists.
anomalies.expected: The spec gives the PCA9685 I2C address as 0x40, which requires A0 (and all address pins) to be tied to GND.
anomalies.impact: The firmware addressing the PWM driver at 0x40 will get no response, so servo outputs will not be driven. (The tie avoids a clash with the INA219 at 0x40 on the same I2C2 bus, so this may be an intentional deviation from the spec.)

anomalies.observed: The FCC crystal (HSE1) is wired to PE6 (pin 5) and PE7 (pin 37). The HSE oscillator pins on this package are PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13). PH0 instead has a 2.2 uF capacitor C14 to GND, and PH1 is on the VREF+ net with R21 and C30.
anomalies.expected: On the STM32H753 the HSE crystal must be connected to PH0/PH1. The NAVC crystal is wired that way (NAVC1 PH0/PH1 are on the crystal-related nets).
anomalies.impact: The FCC's external 25 MHz crystal may not oscillate, so the high-speed clock would fall back to HSI and the timing-dependent flight functions could be affected.
